description.en: The ID of the IPv4 gateway.

description.zh:
要查询IPv4网关实例的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the IPv4 gateway.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc get-ipv4-gateway-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipv4-gateway-id ipv4gw-5tsnc6s4ogsedtp3k0000 --region cn-hangzhou
